records.issue_text: TopicEmbed.import performs a check-then-create on embed_url without locking, allowing concurrent imports of the same URL to race on the unique index and raise an unhandled RecordNotUnique after the post has already been created
records.rationale: In TopicEmbed.import, it does `embed = TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first` and if blank enters a transaction that creates a Post and then does `TopicEmbed.create!(embed_url: url, ...)`. The migration adds a unique index on `topic_embeds.embed_url`. records.issue_text: The -c/--category option in lib/tasks/disqus.thor was removed outright instead of deprecated, silently breaking existing script invocations that pass --category
records.rationale: The diff explicitly removes `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` in `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` and deletes the associated `category_id` lookup and passing `category: category_id` into `PostCreator`. Any existing Thor task invocation using `-c/--category` will now fail due to an unknown option (breaking the CLI interface), and there is no deprecation/compat handling shown in the diff.

No test coverage exists for TopicEmbed.import_remote, leaving the Readability-based remote-fetch/parsing logic untested
records.rationale: The diff adds `TopicEmbed.import_remote` (app/models/topic_embed.rb) which performs network fetch/parsing via `open(url).read` and `Readability::Document.new(...)`, but the only new model spec (spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb) covers `.import` and does not exercise `.import_remote`. No other added specs directly test the Readability-based remote-fetch logic.
